name: Tilia cordata extract
description: Tilia cordata extract (CAS 84929-52-2 ), derived from the flowers and leaves of small-leaved linden, is a botanical ingredient used across cosmetic, food, and pharmaceutical formulations. It delivers antioxidant activity, moisture-retention properties, and a characteristic floral note that supports both functional and sensory performance in finished products for various industries. In skincare and haircare formulations, the extract functions as a humectant and antioxidant, helping to condition skin and stabilize sensitive formulations against oxidative degradation. Food and beverage manufacturers incorporate it as a natural flavoring, where its mild floral-honey profile suits herbal teas, confectionery, and functional drinks for consumers. Nutraceutical and supplement producers use it for its antioxidant content, particularly in products targeting general wellness positioning and high-quality botanical dietary supplements. Pharmaceutical formulators apply it in oral preparations and topical products where botanical-derived soothing and stabilizing properties are required for specific therapeutic applications. Tilia cordata extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or glycerin-based solution, depending on the intended application and the specific manufacturing requirements. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with solvent-free and hydroglycolic variants available for clean-label and natural formulations for global distribution.
